newsitem.title: FRANCE: Aga Khan's daughter engaged to Briton.
newsitem.headline: Aga Khan's daughter engaged to Briton.

text.p: Prince Aga Khan announced on Monday the engagement of his only daughter, 26-year-old Princess Zahra, to a 35-year-old British management consultant, Mark Boyden.
The prince's office said the couple, who met in France two years ago, planned to marry early in the summer and would divide their time between Britain and France.
Zahra, who has two younger brothers, graduated from U.S. Harvard University in Third World Development studies and deals with social activities in Asia and Africa at her father's secretariat.
London-born Boyden, 35, graduated in business administration and ethics from Oxford Brookes University and works as a consultant while also dealing with his family's farming interests.
The spiritual leader of the Ismaili Moslems, the wealthy Aga Khan is also known as a keen racehorse owner.
